RemoveHtml.title: Remove HTML
RemoveHtml.description: Paste HTML (e.g. a jjwxc chapter copied with the bookmarklet below) to strip tags and decode obfuscated characters.
RemoveHtml.bookmarkletDescription: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar, then click it on a jjwxc VIP chapter page to copy the chapter's HTML.
